Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidSimulationBindings

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidSimulationBindings
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PidSimulationBindings extends Object implements Serializable
Revision-bound P&ID identities mapped explicitly to executable simulation elements.

Only names, types and fingerprints are retained. Resolution always uses the supplied process copy, so a scenario cannot obtain a reference to the original equipment through this register. Unbound proposals remain visible; a drawing does not provide the missing physical models, fluid, controller tuning or safety logic.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
